**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (mind the stack note below).

Reviewed head c0fbedc9, trial-merged with current main (clean, no conflicts). This change is under the safety floor (thread-milling motion and feeds), so I looked specifically for loosened refusals and for moved goldens.

**What looks good**
- The kernel only adds refusals: an R plane that is not finite, above the link plane, or below a feature's top is refused by name (`thread_mill.rs`, `ThreadParams::validate`); `r_z: None` keeps the #894 ride. I found no path where a case refused before now passes.
- The door (`thread_r_plane::door`) and the stock law (`thread_r_plane::judge`, called before the way-in laws) add refusals only; an unknown prior or unreadable disc is left to the existing laws, which already refuse it by name.
- With the default (Top of Model) the rapid now stops at or above the feature top, never below, so the change errs on the safe side.
- Goldens: the only golden this PR adds relative to its parent #1219 is `thread_mill_raised_r_plane.cl`; no existing golden moved (checked against the #1219 head). The thread goldens that differ from main come from #1137 and #1219, not from this PR.
- Pinning tests at kernel, golden, app and unit level, a decision record, provenance line on the new module (124 lines), no dependency, build.rs, script or process-file changes.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion lib | 257 passed, 4 ignored |
| camcraft-motion `machining2d` | 66 passed |
| camcraft-app thread_entry / thread_boss / thread_passes / thread_mill / thread_mill_rim | 8 / 12 / 4 / 8 / 11 passed |
| camcraft-app golden_cl, solid_law_goldens (incl. posted thread gate), hole_wall_flats, coarse_rims, mill2d_c, posting | 32 / 7 / 5 / 5 / 9 / 17 passed |
| camcraft-app mcp + lib, filter `thread` | 20 and 3 passed |
| camcraft-ui lib, filter `thread` (from `crates/ui`) | 6 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings`, motion + app + ui, all targets | clean |

I did not run the whole app and ui suites; the plan from `cargo xtask gate quick` was narrowed to the thread-related binaries above.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Stack: the PR targets `main`, but its branch carries the unmerged #1137 and #1219 (the body says merge order #1137 -> #1219 -> this). Merging this one first would land all three at once; merge the parents first, or accept that the diff here includes them. Only the #1212 part was reviewed in detail (see the golden check above).
2. Behaviour change: posted thread-mill G-code changes whenever the operation's R plane (`top_z`) differs from a feature's top (the rapid and the feed start move to R). Existing fixtures all state R on the top, so no posted golden moved. Whether a `fix` subject is right for this (issue #1212 is labelled enhancement) is the maintainer's call.
3. UI files under `crates/ui/src` changed (`thread_page.rs`, `holes_page.rs`, tests); the body carries no screenshots. Most of that comes from the stacked parents.
4. Two MCP test fixtures were moved onto the block's top to keep their refusals; the refusals they pin are unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Update to the review above: main moved while this review ran, and head c0fbedc9 now conflicts with it (`assets/posts/fanuc.cps`; GitHub reports CONFLICTING). <!-- pr-reviewer: 1f1588f32a3f2fa282465025a9f2649f3aafe35b -->
**Review (M3, safety tier) of this PR's delta over #1219: ready for the maintainer to merge, after #1219.**

The thread mill's feed now starts at the R plane, where every rapid stops. The feed can never start below stock, and a rapid can never end in material. Three checks enforce this:
- **Door** (`thread_r_plane::door`, in both of `thread_op::door`'s exits): a fixed R plane below a hole's or boss's top is refused by name, a NaN plane included.
- **Kernel** (`thread_mill.rs` `validate`): an `r_z` above the link plane or below any feature's top is refused, never clamped. `rapid_z = r_z.max(top).max(run_out)`.
- **Stock** (`thread_r_plane::judge`): a vertical rapid that ends below the highest column of prior stock under the tool is refused by name.

**Mutations,** each turning `thread_r_plane` red:
- the door removed from the branch where the pitch is unstated;
- the sideways filter removed;
- the rapid-up filter removed;
- the rapid-kind filter removed.

**The remerge:** the net diff is exactly this PR's 15 files, and the latest merges have empty remerge-diffs. One golden is new (`thread_mill_raised_r_plane.cl`); no existing golden changed.

**Local results:** all pass and clippy is clean.
- `thread_passes` 5, `thread_mill` 8, `thread_mill_rim` 11, `thread_boss` 12, `thread_entry` 8;
- `drill_rplane` 8, `hole_wall_flats` 5, `golden_cl` 32, `solid_law_goldens` 7, `mcp` 22;
- app lib `thread` 23, motion lib 264.
Merged. Release notes: with the default Top-of-Model R plane, thread operations whose mouth stands above the model top are now refused by name (fail-closed); list this as a behaviour change.
